meta.name: polder_village
meta.prompt: A flat polder village of dykes and drainage canals, with one great brick windmill pumping the water out, its sails turning over the reed beds.

programs.brief: A monumental octagonal brick drainage windmill with a thatched rotating cap, massive four-blade lattice sails, and an arched brick culvert scoop wheel pumping canal water out into the drainage basin.

tokens.terrain: flat reclaimed polder land crisscrossed by drainage canals and bounded by dykes, with shallow reed beds
tokens.infra: drainage_canal network separating the fields; earthen dyke along the perimeter water; cart_track along the dyke crest
tokens.icons: a great brick drainage windmill with revolving sails set at the water junction; sluice gates; reed beds fringing the ditch lines
